title: GenOlympiad: Benchmarking Frontier Image Models at Their Capability Boundaries
title_zh: GenOlympiad：在最前沿图像模型的能力边界处进行基准测试

paragraphs.en: 总结：GenOlympiad基准用九大能力轴的高难度提示词压力测试前沿文生图模型，发现最强模型严格得分仅23.9分。 Text-to-image models have made tremendous progress and can produce high-quality images. However, a question which would be asked in any other discipline is where the frontier models fall short. We introduce GenOlympiad, a benchmark which provides the most challenging text prompts from nine capability axes for stress-testing frontier text-to-image models. The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/
paragraphs.zh: 总结：GenOlympiad 基准用九大能力轴的高难度提示词压力测试前沿文生图模型，发现最强模型严格得分仅 23.9 分。文生图模型已取得巨大进展，能够生成高质量图像。 然而，任何其他学科都会提出的一个问题是：前沿模型在哪些方面仍存在不足。 我们提出 GenOlympiad，这是一个基准，提供来自九大能力轴的最具挑战性的文本提示词，用于对前沿文生图模型进行压力测试。 所评估的能力包括生成大数量对象、执行深度推理、确保高难度物理一致性、遵循复杂规则等。 这些提示词的设计使得提示词对齐可以通过视觉方式验证（例如计数），而不依赖于主观判断（例如风格）。 基于此，我们开发了一个自动化评估框架，该框架将提示词分解为简单问题和困难问题，并且对于大多数困难问题，会绘制辅助线以定位证据，从而实现准确评分。 我们评估了 20 多个强大的文生图模型，包括 Nano Banana Pro、GPT-Image-2.5、Seedream-5.0 等。 我们报告称，即使是表现最好的文生图模型（Nano Banana Pro）也只能获得 100 分制下 23.9 分的严格得分，而诸如 GPT-6 Astra 之类的编码模型具有更高的提示词对齐得分（但视觉上不够美观）。 我们还获得了关于模型演进、与 Elo 分数的对齐，以及我们基于定位证据的评估协议有效性的见解。 代码发布于 https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad，项目页面位于 https://genolympiad.github.io/
